name: Alphalens
methods: Cross-sectional factor-to-forward-return alignment and five-quantile bucketing
Mean forward return by quantile and Q5-minus-Q1 spread
Spearman rank information coefficient by date and forward horizon
Top/bottom quantile turnover and factor-rank autocorrelation
Optional factor-weighted long/short and group-neutral return diagnostics
reuseDecision: Implement the published factor-diagnostics method independently in TypeScript; do not run, embed, or port the dormant Python package. If source is later copied or translated, comply with Apache-2.0 redistribution, notice-retention, and modification-notice obligations.
requirements: Timestamped factor scores, point-in-time universe membership, and aligned historical price/mid series through the largest forward horizon
Explicit score-known time, entry-price convention, bar interval, instrument identity, and price-field provenance to prevent look-ahead bias
Optional point-in-time group classification only for user-selected group-neutral analysis
No Alphalens account, API key, live quote feed, broker credential, or paid data subscription is required
Any provider authentication, rate limits, historical coverage, data storage/redistribution rights, and paid access are provider-specific and must be verified before Zax fetches data
